verdict: A near pixel-faithful rebuild where only small offsets remain (featured image shifted 2-3 px, enlarged EN letters, red badges tucked closer to their icons); the layers are well named and mostly auto-layout, but there are no text or color styles and the gaps are fractional magic numbers.

top_defects.what: badge artwork shifted about 2-3 px right/down inside the 415 dp crop (crown finial at x~531 vs ~528 in the reference), which drives the heatmap's 15-27 meanDiff in the image cells
'EN' letters noticeably taller and bolder (12 px Medium vs about 11 px in the reference); the dark box is slightly narrower and its corners tighter
red #b32424 'new' dots sit 2-3 px lower-left, overlapping the icon more than in the reference, where they sit at the icon's top-right corner
no text styles or color variables (styled: 0) and no local main components; spacing is fractional magic numbers (gap 36.2, 24.4, 4.3, 8.35, 12.2)
a Badge ellipse in every nav item (3 hidden or unused), a 'For you' indicator rectangle kept, and a 'Title row' 384 px wide inside a 379 px parent (overflows by 5 px)
the image, scrim, actions and summary are stacked absolutely in a 418 px card, and 38 absolute layers in all; the summary card does not hug to the bottom edge the way the Compose layout does

strengths: Every text, icon and color matches the reference, down to the wrapping and the 'Cheltenham Tr…' ellipsis, Noto Serif title, #3366cc tab and #e8f0ff Home pill
The real Wikipedia wordmark, the globe and the badge are rebuilt from the supplied assets, and the scrim and 92% white summary card match the reference's tones
Clear naming (Header, Tabs bar, Community banner, Featured article card, Nav item – Home…) with tabs, nav items and action buttons as instances
